title: Cell Without Copy
goal: Move non-Copy values in and out of a Cell safely.

sections.text: `Cell<T>` does not require `T` to be `Copy`. For non-`Copy` types like `String`, `Cell::get` is unavailable because it cannot copy the inner value.

sections.caption: get() demands Copy because it returns a value copy.

sections.text: To inspect or modify non-`Copy` data in a `Cell`, you move values in and out instead. `Cell::take` replaces the inner value with default data and returns the old value.

sections.caption: take() leaves String::default() and moves old out.

sections.text: You can also use `Cell::replace` to swap in a new value and receive the old one in one step. No reference is ever handed out, so borrow rules are never violated.

explanation: Move non-Copy values in and out of a Cell safely.
